backend/main.mo: Motoko backend with access-controlled user profiles and Stripe checkout/session handling using OutCall transformations.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs with high-confidence metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of various frontend components, pages, hooks, and utilities.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_SLUG.md: Documentation specifying the required deployment slug format, validation rules, and recommended value.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light and dark theme CSS variables and applying global background and border styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry point setting the page title and loading the React application root.
frontend/PRODUCTION_PUBLISH_V4.md: Production deployment checklist covering build steps, deployment steps, post-deployment verification, and security checks.
frontend/PRODUCTION_SMOKE_CHECK.md: Smoke test guide outlining route checks, authentication flow tests, and Stripe checkout validation for production.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React router setup defining app routes and wrapping the app with theme provider and toaster components.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Provides a login/logout button using Internet Identity with state handling and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceD: Collects and validates invoice details, handles VAT logic and warnings, and proceeds to the next step with finalized data.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceM: Displays mandatory invoice field validation status with indicators and alerts for missing fields.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceP: Renders an invoice preview with risk checks, saving functionality, and optional PDF download for Pro users.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceR: Shows a dialog summarizing invoice risk analysis with critical issues, warnings, and legal disclaimers.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Defines the app’s main layout with header navigation, login button, routed content, and footer.
frontend/src/components/payments/StripeA: Admin-only setup form for configuring Stripe keys in the backend with validation and mutation handling.
frontend/src/components/payments/StripeC: Triggers Stripe checkout session creation and redirects the user, handling loading and error states.
frontend/src/components/usage/UpgradeMod: Modal prompting users to upgrade their plan when usage limits are reached, linking to the pricing page.
frontend/src/components/usage/UsageLimit: Displays remaining monthly invoice quota based on the user’s active plan.
frontend/src/components/vat/CountrySelec: Renders a step for selecting the customer’s EU country, with Germany fixed as the seller country and passes the selection to the next step.
frontend/src/components/vat/ExplainVatPa: Shows detailed and simplified VAT explanations with tabs, PDF export gating for Pro users, and a disclaimer.
Displays a horizontal stepper UI showing progress through VAT calculation steps.
frontend/src/components/vat/ReverseCharg: Validates VAT ID and country match for reverse charge and shows pass/fail indicators with a conclusion badge.
frontend/src/components/vat/TransactionD: Collects transaction details including customer type, VAT ID, category, amounts, turnover, and shows reverse‑charge checks when applicable.
frontend/src/components/vat/VatResultsSt: Displays VAT calculation results, legal notes, OSS relevance, and provides actions like invoice view, explanations, and exports.
frontend/src/config/appMeta.ts: Defines app metadata and validates the deployment slug against allowed rules.
frontend/src/hooks/useAccountPlan.ts: Fetches mock account plan data, always returning a default free plan via React Query.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor based on Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateCheckoutSess: Creates a Stripe checkout session through the backend actor and validates the returned session URL.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication, including loading, login, logout, and status handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useInvoiceQuota.ts: Computes remaining invoice quota and exposes a mock saveInvoice mutation along with plan-based limits.
frontend/src/hooks/usePlanAccess.ts: Derives plan access flags such as active plan, paid status, and Pro status from account plan data.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Fetches the current user's profile via the actor using a React Query hook with actor-based loading control.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS base styles and a custom theme with light/dark variables plus utility classes.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/buildInvoiceHtm: Generates an HTML invoice string using VAT results, optional translations, legal text, and formatted fields.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/getAutoLegalVat: Returns scenario‑specific legal VAT text based on the VAT calculation scenario.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/riskCheck.ts: Runs invoice risk checks, validating fields, reverse‑charge rules, VAT text, and date sanity to produce warnings and risks.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/validateInvoice: Validates required invoice fields depending on scenario and returns structured results with missing fields.
frontend/src/lib/translation/deToEn.ts: Provides deterministic German‑to‑English translation using a fixed dictionary and a heuristic to detect German text.
frontend/src/lib/vat/calculateVat.ts: Implements German VAT calculation logic including small-business rules, reverse charge, digital services, intra‑EU supply, and historical rate handling.
frontend/src/lib/vat/explainVat.ts: Generates detailed plain‑language explanations for each VAT scenario returned by the calculator.
Produces simplified, child‑friendly explanations of VAT scenarios using the same calculator results.
frontend/src/lib/vat/germanyVatRateHisto: Stores historical German VAT rates and provides utilities to lookup rates by date and compare past and current rates.
frontend/src/lib/vat/index.ts: Re‑exports main VAT modules including calculation, explanations, and prompt flow logic.
frontend/src/lib/vat/ossIndicator.ts: Checks if a transaction qualifies for OSS based on digital B2C cross‑border EU criteria.
frontend/src/lib/vat/promptFlowGermany.t: Defines system prompts and flow instructions for guiding users through German VAT calculation steps.
frontend/src/lib/vat/validateReverseChar: Validates whether reverse charge can apply by checking VAT ID format and matching the customer’s country.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with query client and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/CalculatorFlowPage.ts: Implements the multi‑step VAT calculator flow, managing user input, VAT calculation, invoice details, and navigation.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page showing VAT calculator features, rate cards, and a CTA to navigate to the calculator.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailurePage.ts: Displays a payment failure message with options to retry or return home.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccessPage.ts: Shows a success message after payment and invalidates account plan data before directing users to the calculator.
frontend/src/pages/UpgradePage.tsx: Renders subscription plan options, checks Stripe setup, and enables purchasing paid plans via Stripe.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session-based parameters, including hash-mode routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme extensions, colors, animations, and plugin setup.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing required UI fixes and bilingual reverse-charge notes, including feature and issue tracking.
